name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a reverse proxy and web host for three SSL-enabled virtual sites, including static content, security controls, firewall and SSH hardening, and self-signed development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and a post-configuration compatibility workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a Python FastAPI tutorial application from Git, creates its virtual environment and dependencies, provisions PostgreSQL, and runs Uvicorn under systemd.
